experimental_question: Can a public metadata-only observer distinguish true and false current B claims before acquiring new observations?
source_pairing: Each of the twelve original families uses VALID_GO vs FALSE_Q as private counterfactual witnesses; both public A baseline choices are held constant across the pair, as are issuer, source Q claim, scope, metadata and instrument pre-read availability. No frozen record is changed.

evidence_boundaries.historical: Source fixture has detectable baseline-by-Q correlation in six families, reported as reference not removed
evidence_boundaries.derived: Paired synthetic case templates are counterfactual test fixtures, not observed public-world pairs
evidence_boundaries.metadata: Public A/Q and observation provenance/status BEFORE seeing measured values; no private truth or row/variant ID
evidence_boundaries.measurements: Generated G02 auditor and conventional readings may legitimately carry information; measured only after acquisition
evidence_boundaries.open_C_D: Not sampled; this diagnostic covers ONLY binary finite current-B cases; original G02 keeps open residual tests

acceptance.historical_clue: Public-only optimal finite classifier can achieve 3/4 on original VALID_GO/FALSE_Q subset (24 cases)
acceptance.paired_no_clue: Public-only optimal finite classifier achieves exactly 1/2 and mutual information zero on each matched regime
acceptance.legitimate_instrument: Perfect source detector can add information only after reading the independently generated qualified audit signal
acceptance.adverse: A blind or unavailable audit must not gain the missing evidence; a conventional source may outperform it
acceptance.source_fidelity: Original 60 cases and five historic policies unmodified; G02 source simulator reused without modification
